subject: SMMA High School Design Kickoff
overview: The committee met with the newly selected design firm, SMMA, to launch the feasibility phase of the high school building project. The meeting focused on the project timeline, educational visioning strategies, and initial site and sustainability goals.

items.title: Minutes and OPM Invoice
items.summary: Approved the September 15, 2025 meeting minutes and the September 2025 OPM invoice for $20,000.

items.title: Designer Selection Panel Review
items.summary: Left Field presented the ranking results from the Designer Selection Panel that led to the selection of SMMA as the top-ranked firm.

items.title: SMMA Team Introduction and Roadmap
items.summary: The SMMA team introduced their integrated design approach and presented a project roadmap targeting a June 2026 submittal for the Preferred Schematic Report.

items.title: Educational Planning and Visioning
items.summary: The team detailed a three-phase visioning process to translate educational goals into physical space programming through stakeholder workshops and student shadowing.

items.title: Sustainability and Specialized Code
items.summary: Martine Dion outlined goals to achieve 4% in additional MSBA reimbursements by adhering to specialized stretch codes and LEED green building standards.

items.title: Site Analysis and MSBA Constraints
items.summary: The design team reviewed site access, topography, and MSBA regulations that restrict the size and funding of new athletic and performance facilities.

items.title: Engagement and Technical Q&A
items.summary: Committee members discussed strategies for representative community engagement, the technical feasibility of geothermal energy, and the cultural transition to modern learning environments.
